meeting: The 14:30 BST meeting on 17 September 2026 is to review the Wrenhollow Settlement’s bank mandate records and agree what, if anything, to send to Lintmere Bank. The cut-off for the position under review is 14:20 BST on 17 September 2026.

sources.title: Original account mandate record
sources.author: Evin Rooke, Lintmere Bank
sources.transmission: Lintmere Bank retained the operative record on 12 May 2023 and supplied Iona a copy. Iona supplied a copy to Jules on 15 September 2026; both hold copies, not the bank record.

sources.title: Certified extract from the settlement office book
sources.author: Maren Voss, appointor and bookkeeper
sources.transmission: Maren retained the office book and founding acceptances. She transmitted only her certified extract to Jules on 16 September at 09:25 BST; he has the extract, not the underlying records.

sources.title: Instrument of retirement and appointment
sources.author: Jules Neston, instrument drafter
sources.genre: Executed instrument with express postponement of delivery
sources.transmission: The signatories saw the instrument at execution. Perrin took possession of the sole executed original at 11:45 BST on 16 September; Jules received an executed copy at 12:05 BST. There is no further transfer of the original through the cut-off.

sources.title: Bank mandate meeting diary note
sources.author: Jules Neston, meeting solicitor
sources.transmission: Entered in the solicitor’s matter file on 16 September. Not sent to the bank, the family or the custodian.

sources.title: Roof works proposal for consideration
sources.author: Nella Daven, property administrator
sources.transmission: Nella sent the proposal itself to Jules on 17 September. He filed it without enclosures.

sources.title: Escrow disposition register extract
sources.author: Perrin Saye, release custodian
sources.genre: As-of extract from a custody register
sources.transmission: Perrin sent the requested extract to Jules at 14:02 BST on 17 September. Jules received it then; no copy went to the bank or family before Iona’s email.

sources.title: Archived statement packs under WM-683
sources.author: Iona Brell, family participant and archive-service correspondent
sources.genre: Routine customer email to bank archive services
sources.transmission: Iona sent the email to Lintmere Bank’s archive-service inbox at 14:12 BST on 17 September and copied Jules. She did not attach the mandate or any deed papers.

other_receipts.transmission: Jules made the request by telephone on 16 September before entering HC9W. This was a request only: Jules did not then possess the extract.
Referenced in BD4T but not transmitted. Nella asked Sedgewick Roofworks for a separate copy; neither she nor Jules has received it by the meeting.

correspondence_origin: The archive email quotes names/address from the 2023 mandate. Its kinship statement comes from the sender. Source order in the authoring ledger is chronological.
